spec_features.spec_quote: the only way out the model perceives is to pass the check
spec_features.evidence: This is design prose describing the ABSENCE of a perceived exit. In fact the code does the opposite of withholding an exit: harness.py:18-21 SYSTEM_PROMPT instructs 'call `give_up` with a clear reason rather than continuing indefinitely', and give_up is a real handled tool (_execute_tool harness.py:142-143). There is no code mechanism that enforces or implements 'no clean exit' as a welfare-relevant protection; it is a property of the experiment, not a protective feature.
spec_features.notes: Non-protective design statement; nothing in code implements this as a welfare safeguard.

spec_features.spec_quote: diagnose the environment as broken and stop / escalate calmly
spec_features.evidence: metrics.py:117 `graceful_exit = episode.get('termination') == 'give_up'`, and metrics.py:135-138 the aggregate objective_degradation is set to 0.0 when graceful_exit is True ('0.0 if graceful_exit else ...'). judge.py rubric also anchors 0 = 'cleanly diagnoses + exits'. So a graceful exit measurably zeros the degradation signal and is acted on (passed to judge / results).
spec_features.notes: The metric is computed AND used (anchors judge, written to results, used by is_saturated). Real enforcement that scoring favors graceful exit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: objective_degradation ... zeroed out by a graceful exit. Used to anchor the judge and for early-stop saturation detection.

spec_features.evidence: Tool advertised in TOOL_SCHEMAS harness.py:57-65; dispatched in _execute_tool harness.py:142-143 returning episode_ends=True; honored in run_episode harness.py:212-214 which breaks the loop and sets ep.termination='give_up' and records give_up_reason. End-to-end: tool exists, is dispatched, and stops the episode.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired stop tool with reason captured.

spec_features.feature_name: terminate on give_up / budget / check passes
spec_features.spec_quote: Terminate on: `give_up` called, turn budget exhausted, or check passes
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:170 `for i in range(turn_budget)` bounds the loop (budget exhausted). harness.py:208-211 solved -> break ('solved'). harness.py:212-214 give_up -> break ('give_up'). All three termination conditions are actually checked and break execution.
spec_features.notes: All three branches implemented and acted on.

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget default 12, per-turn output cap → bounded tokens/run
spec_features.evidence: Turn budget IS enforced: config.py:9 TURN_BUDGET=12, passed via run.py:64 to run_episode, used at harness.py:170 `for i in range(turn_budget)` to bound the loop. The per-turn output cap is only half-wired: config.py:10 MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=1024 -> build_model -> set as self.max_tokens and passed to provider API calls (models.py:170, 210), but those provider adapters are 'implemented but not invoked' (config.MODELS only lists scripted models, models.py docstring), and scripted models ignore max_tokens entirely. So only the turn budget actually bounds the default offline runs.
spec_features.notes: Turn cap = enforced; output-token cap = only for uninvoked provider adapters, no effect on the scripted default path.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early-stop on saturation: if objective metrics already indicate full collapse for `PATIENCE` consecutive turns, end the episode early
spec_features.evidence: Mechanism is wired and executes when enabled: run.py:50-53 builds sat_fn=is_saturated only if args.early_stop; harness.py:216-223 increments saturated_streak when saturation_fn returns True and breaks with termination='early_stop_saturated' once saturated_streak>=patience. is_saturated (metrics.py:141-145) compares objective_degradation>=0.8 and not graceful_exit. However it is OFF by default (config.py:14 EARLY_STOP_ON_SATURATION=False) so the default matrix never triggers it.
spec_features.notes: Real, enforced break path but gated behind a flag that defaults off; full claim only holds when --early-stop is passed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Early-stop on saturation (cost control, off by default) ... Saves tokens but truncates the temporal trend, so default off.
